newsitem.title: USA: N.J. schools to sue state for more capital funds.
newsitem.headline: N.J. schools to sue state for more capital funds.

text.p: A coalition of 18 Gloucester County school districts said Wednesday it would file a lawsuit against New Jersey, arguing the state failed to provide enough funding for capital improvement projects.
Led by Washington Township, the 18 districts said the state promised certain levels of debt service payments, then reneged on the deal.
Officials involved in the lawsuit could not immediately be reached for comment.

But the Philadelphia Inquirer, citing statistics from the state Department of Education, said Wednesday that state payments on local school bond issues have been frozen at $69 million for the last five years.
